Pinned and authored cases prove malformed/recursive/conditional/content-model declarations, first-declaration precedence, normalized defaults/entities, every split/push-source boundary, initial scalar cursor/absolute mappings, aggregate exact/one-over quotas, cancellation and borrowed input release.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.
